paper_title: Towards 360° Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning

tasks.name: FrontTrack
tasks.description: Follow a designated moving target while preserving the UAV’s initial heading, including when target motion changes its viewing direction.

tasks.name: FrontUnderpass
tasks.description: Track a front-initialized target through an underpass, where geometry and clearance challenge persistent observation and control.

tasks.name: FrontApproach
tasks.description: Approach and follow a designated target from a frontal configuration, coordinating distance regulation with three-dimensional motion.

tasks.name: FrontSelection
tasks.description: Preserve the identity of a front-initialized target among visually related distractors using the designated-instance reference.

tasks.name: NonFrontTrack
tasks.description: Acquire and follow a target outside the initial frontal view, using full-spherical observations instead of yaw search.

tasks.name: DroneTrack
tasks.description: Acquire and track an aerial target across full-spherical viewing directions, extending beyond ground-target following.

tasks.name: NonFrontApproach
tasks.description: Approach a target from a non-frontal configuration and transition into sustained following.

tasks.name: NonFrontSelection
tasks.description: Identify and follow a non-front-initialized target among distractors, combining acquisition with instance-specific tracking.
